mainEntity.name: Should I retexture my ceiling or smooth it out completely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a flat, smooth ceiling provides a modern, clean design, but it requires significantly more labor and cost than a textured finish. Smooth finishes demand a Level 5 drywall finish, where the entire ceiling receives multiple skim coats and thorough sanding to eliminate any trace of joints, fasteners, or framing imperfections. By contrast, light textures like orange peel or knockdown diffuse ceiling light, naturally concealing minor structural framing dips or sheetrock variations. If your home has slight joist unevenness, a textured ceiling is often the more cost-effective and forgiving option compared to smooth plaster or drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth ceilings offer a sleek look but require higher labor costs to hide flaws. Textured ceilings diffuse light and disguise minor joist unevenness more economically.
